title: Transmission lines · HIFLD · segments
description: Segments of the HIFLD national transmission-line file inside the contiguous United States, with the recorded voltage, voltage class, owner and status of each segment, and a voltage band shared by all transmission layers of the project. Alaska and Hawaii are not covered.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: ID of the segment in the HIFLD file, kept as a string. It is the reference of the record to the source.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Owner of the line as recorded in the HIFLD file.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status recorded in the HIFLD file: IN SERVICE or NOT AVAILABLE.

fields.name: voltage_kv
fields.null_meaning: No voltage is recorded for the segment in the source file.
fields.description: Voltage of the segment in kilovolts, as recorded in the HIFLD file.

fields.name: voltage_class
fields.description: Voltage class of the segment (v69, v115, v138, v230, v345, v500, ge765 or lt69_unknown), as used by the project's county layer.

fields.name: voltage_band
fields.description: Band common to the project's transmission layers, computed from voltage_kv: lt100, 100_199, 200_299, 300_399, 400_599, ge600, dc or unknown. The class is used only when there is no number; unknown means no usable voltage.

coverage.geography: Contiguous United States and the District of Columbia
known_gaps: Alaska and Hawaii are not covered.

HIFLD Open, the public portal that distributed this file, was discontinued by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security on 26 August 2025; the announcement gave no reason. The layer uses an archived copy of the national file (copy of 26 February 2026; newest record 26 September 2024). Other public archives of the file exist, for example DataLumos (DOI 10.3886/E240591V1); which archive our copy came from was not recorded, and it has not been matched to them record by record.
No segment in the file is marked as direct current, so the band dc is empty in this release.
The archive carries no dataset metadata; license status is taken from the publisher's metadata for the same edition (30 Sep 2024).
14,069 of 93,880 segments have no usable voltage; their voltage_band is unknown.

verification.method: Segments are published as recorded in the source file; only voltage_band is computed, by script, from voltage_kv. Values of -999999, the source's code for a missing voltage, are published as empty, and so are values of zero or less. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
record_id (the HIFLD ID) is present and unique in all 93,880 segments; none has an empty geometry.
Originator, other constraints and use limitation cut from the saved copy of the publisher's metadata for the same edition (PSU Data Commons) and compared with the expected public-domain wording.
